scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @myoc/backend && npm run build --workspace @myoc/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @myoc/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @myoc/web
scripts.deadcode: npm run deadcode:production && npm run deadcode:nonproduction
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage:ci && npm run deadcode && npm run containers:check
scripts.db:prepare:local: node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply myoc-db --local -c apps/backend/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs d1 execute myoc-db --local -c apps/backend/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state --file apps/backend/seeds/development.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy --workspace @myoc/backend && npm run deploy --workspace @myoc/web
